key_findings: 5 demon crime methods across 69 cases · Forceful Plunder most common (25 cases) · Magic Threat most dangerous (50% success rate)
10 distress signals with average 42.5% survival · Wukong's Fiery Eyes most reliable (80%) · crying least effective (5%)
10 mount-desertion cases with average sentence severity only 2.8/10 · 0% actual punishment rate · revealing judicial double standards
60%+ wild-demon mortality vs 0% mount-desertion mortality · background decides life and death
cross_concept_insight: Three findings of monster sociology: 1) crime methods are positively correlated with treasure tier; 2) Tang Sanzang's survival depends heavily on Wukong · his own survival ability is extremely weak; 3) Xiyouji justice is a classic 'background decides the verdict' · mount desertion is the 'judicial immunity pass' of the privileged class
methodology_note: Data based on the original 100 chapters of Journey to the West · case counts and verdicts are qualitative analysis · severity uses a subjective 1–10 score
